model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is specifically optimized for whole-brain immunolabeling with superior antibody penetration, which is critical for detecting endogenous c-Fos expression (a marker for neuronal activation) throughout the entire 10 mm adult mouse brain. It achieves high transparency and is compatible with light-sheet microscopy, allowing for the reconstruction of single-cell resolution 3D maps. The use of Alexa Fluor 647 provides deep tissue penetration and minimal autofluorescence, while DAPI serves as a nuclear counterstain for anatomical registration.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) overnight.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS for 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Normal Donkey Serum in PBS for 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Rabbit anti-c-Fos antibody (1:1000) in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 10 mg/ml Heparin, 0.1% Sodium Azide in PBS) with 5% DMSO and 3% Normal Donkey Serum for 7-14 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 336 hours)

7 Washes
7.1 Wash with PTwH for 1 day, changing solution at least 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

8 Secondary Antibody Incubation
8.1 Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PTwH with 3% Normal Donkey Serum for 7-14 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 336 hours)

9 Washes
9.1 Wash with PTwH for 1 day, changing solution at least 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

10 Nuclear Staining
10.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/ml) in PTwH for 2 days.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

11 Dehydration (Pre-clearing)
11.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

12 Delipidation
12.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for 30 minutes to clear until tissue is transparent, repeat once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

13 Refractive Index Matching
13.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) until the tissue sinks and is fully transparent (approx. 15-30 minutes). Store in DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

The method's solvent-based clearing (using methanol and dichloromethane) efficiently removes lipids from the dense brain and tumor tissue, rendering it transparent for deep light-sheet microscopy. The dual labeling strategy targets CD31 (endothelial cells) to visualize the vascular network and Collagen IV (basement membrane) to assess blood-brain barrier integrity and vessel morphology. DAPI provides nuclear context to delineate tumor boundaries. Alexa Fluor dyes are highly stable in the iDISCO+ solvents, ensuring strong signal retention for 3D reconstruction.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS
**Chosen Labeling:** [Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI, MAP2]
**Justification:** ScaleS is an aqueous-based clearing method specifically optimized for high fluorescence preservation and fine structural resolution (such as dendrites and spines), making it superior to solvent-based methods (like uDISCO or iDISCO+) for retaining weak endogenous signals. Its use of urea and sorbitol/glycerol is gentle on fluorescent proteins and compatible with long-term storage. The labeling strategy employs MAP2 conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 to specifically highlight dendritic architecture and complement the weak endogenous signal, while DAPI provides nuclear context for registration. Alexa Fluor 647 offers high photostability and deep tissue penetration, essential for 3D reconstruction and 6-month archival.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Washing
1.1 Incubation with 1x PBS (pH 7.4) for 1 hour to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with fresh 1x PBS (pH 7.4) for another 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Clearing and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with ScaleA2 solution (4 M Urea, 10% w/v Glycerol, 0.1% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 0.1 M Phosphate Buffer, pH 7.5) for 4 days to clear and permeabilize the tissue.(Temperature: RT, Time: 96 hours)

3 Primary Antibody Labeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody solution: Rabbit anti-MAP2 (1:500) diluted in ScaleA2(0) (4 M Urea, 10% w/v Glycerol in 0.1 M Phosphate Buffer, pH 7.5) for 10 days to ensure deep penetration into the 3 mm tissue block.(Temperature: RT, Time: 240 hours)

4 Washing
4.1 Incubation with ScaleA2(0) solution for 12 hours to remove unbound primary antibodies.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with fresh ScaleA2(0) solution for another 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
5.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody solution: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) diluted in ScaleA2(0) for 7 days protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 168 hours)

6 Washing
6.1 Incubation with ScaleA2(0) solution for 12 hours to remove unbound secondary antibodies and dye.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
6.2 Incubation with fresh ScaleA2(0) solution for another 12 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

7 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
7.1 Incubation with ScaleB4 solution (4 M Urea, 50% w/v Glycerol, 0.1% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 0.1 M Phosphate Buffer, pH 7.5) for 2 days to match the refractive index.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
7.2 Long-term storage in fresh ScaleB4 solution at 4°C in the dark for up to 6 months prior to imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 months)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Tuj1 + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior capability in clearing whole embryos (8-10 mm) while preserving fine neuronal structures for high-resolution 3D reconstruction. The method's robust immunolabeling protocol ensures deep penetration of antibodies into the dense tissue of E12.5 embryos, which is critical for visualizing the continuous paths of cranial and spinal nerves. Tuj1 (β-III Tubulin) is the gold standard marker for visualizing early neuronal projections and axons, while DAPI provides essential nuclear context for anatomical orientation of the head, brainstem, and spinal cord. Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its far-red emission, which penetrates cleared tissue effectively with minimal autofluorescence.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Washing and Methanol Dehydration
1.1 Wash samples with 1x PBS (pH 7.4) containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2) in Methanol (freshly prepared) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS (PBST) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 5% Normal Donkey Serum, 5% DMSO in 1x PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Anti-Tuj1 antibody diluted 1:500 in Blocking Solution). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)

7 Washing
7.1 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS (PBST) with gentle shaking (change solution daily). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

8 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
8.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:500 and DAPI diluted 1:1000 in Blocking Solution). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)

9 Washing
9.1 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS (PBST) with gentle shaking (change solution daily). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

10 Dehydration for Clearing
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

11 Clearing
11.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for lipid removal. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
11.2 Incubation with fresh Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

12 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DiBenzyl Ether (DBE) until sample is transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours to overnight)

The method's solvent-based clearing (Methanol/DCM/DBE) renders the 8mm tumor highly transparent, ideal for 3D light-sheet microscopy. The use of Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 conjugated antibodies ensures high photostability and brightness to distinguish Pan-T (CD3) and Cytotoxic T (CD8) cells deep within the tumor core. DAPI is included to define nuclear density, enabling the segmentation of tumor core versus edge regions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Bleaching and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to quench autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Wash with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) with 0.2% Tween-20 (PTw2). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Blocking
2.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PTw2 + 0.1% Sodium Azide + 5% DMSO + 3% Normal Donkey Serum + 10 mg/ml Heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Primary Antibody Incubation
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (Rat anti-mouse CD3, Rat anti-mouse CD8) diluted in Blocking Solution + 1% DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
3.2 Wash with PTw2. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Wash with PTw2. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

4.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 488 for CD3, Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 for CD8) diluted in Blocking Solution + 1% DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
4.2 Wash with PTw2. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Wash with PTw2. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

5 Dehydration
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

6 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3, CD8, CD31 (PECAM1), DAPI] + [Alexa Fluor]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is the gold standard for whole-mount immunolabeling and clearing of large, dense tissues like tumors (up to several mm). It utilizes methanol dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation, which effectively removes lipids from the tumor mass to achieve high transparency while preserving antigenicity for deep antibody penetration. This is critical for visualizing the spatial distribution of T cell subpopulations (CD3, CD8) relative to vasculature (CD31) from the tumor boundary to the necrotic core. The method also effectively quenches autofluorescence, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio for specific immune cell detection.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS for 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.3M Glycine in PBS for 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (Rabbit anti-CD3, Rat anti-CD8, Hamster anti-CD31) diluted in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 5 ug/ml Heparin in PBS) with 5% DMSO and 3% Normal Donkey Serum for 7 days.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)

7 Wash

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并匹配适合脂肪组织三维成像的透明方法。若限制范围内的 Lectin 或 IB4 可以直接标记灌流血管腔面，应优先作为血管辅助通道；交感神经纤维身份仍需由神经相关表内靶点完成。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH, Lectin, Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is highly effective for delipidating lipid-rich tissues like white adipose tissue (WAT) through its dichloromethane (DCM) step, which is crucial for clearing the 15 mm fat pad. The protocol includes a bleaching step to reduce the high autofluorescence often associated with adipose tissue. It is optimized for deep immunolabeling of thick tissues, allowing for the detection of Tyrosine Hydroxylase (TH) to identify sympathetic nerve fibers. Lectin is prioritized for vascular labeling as requested, and DAPI is included for nuclear counterstaining to provide spatial context.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN+Alexa Fluor 488, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it utilizes a methanol-based dehydration and bleaching step (H2O2) which is critical for removing the melanin pigment in the RPE layer that is causing strong background and light absorption in your samples. Unlike the aqueous EyeCi/CUBIC protocol you tried previously, iDISCO+ provides superior decolorization of pigmented tissues. Additionally, its organic solvent-based clearing (ending in DBE) achieves a high refractive index (RI ~1.56) suitable for deep imaging of the whole eye. The protocol includes robust permeabilization steps to ensure antibodies (NeuN for RGCs and CD31 for vasculature) penetrate the dense ocular tissue, addressing the weak vascular signal issue.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

2 Bleaching (Crucial for RPE Pigment Removal)
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-16 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

4 Permeabilization

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [Tuj1 + Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 594, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for decalcified bone tissues, offering excellent transparency for dense structures like the skull and femur while preserving fine fluorescence signals. Its aqueous-based refractive index matching (Iodixanol) minimizes tissue shrinkage and fluorescence quenching, which is critical for accurately mapping the 3D spatial relationships between delicate nerve fibers, vasculature, and bone marrow. Tuj1 is selected as a robust pan-neuronal marker to visualize nerve fibers. Lectin is used to specifically label the vascular lumen surface. DAPI provides nuclear staining to reference the marrow structure.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.5) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 10-14 days)
1.2 Replace with fresh 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.5) daily until the bone is pliable. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Daily change)

2 Washing
2.1 Rinse with 1x PBS to remove EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 mins)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3 Permeabilization
3.1 Incubation with BoneClear Reagent A (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

4 Immunostaining (Primary & Lectin)
4.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody (Rabbit anti-Tuj1, 1:500) and Lectin (Alexa Fluor 594 conjugate, 1:100) diluted in BoneClear Reagent B (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.1% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, 5% Donkey Serum in PBS) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5-7 days)

5 Washing
5.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Wash with fresh PBST under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Immunostaining (Secondary)
6.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, 1:500) diluted in BoneClear Reagent B under gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)

7 Washing
7.1 Wash with PBST under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.2 Wash with fresh PBST under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

8 Nuclear Staining
8.1 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000) in PBST under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

9 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
9.1 Incubation with BoneClear Reagent C (80% w/v Iodixanol in PBS) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48-72 hours)

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS
**Chosen Labeling:** [ELKS/CAST/ERC homolog + Alexa Fluor, MAP2 + Alexa Fluor]
**Justification:** ScaleS is specifically optimized for high-resolution imaging of fine neural structures, such as dendritic spines and synaptic puncta, in thick tissue blocks (up to several millimeters). Unlike organic solvent methods (e.g., iDISCO+, uDISCO) that cause significant tissue shrinkage and can quench fluorescence, ScaleS is an aqueous method that minimizes morphological distortion and preserves endogenous fluorescence and antibody signals exceptionally well. This is critical for the quantitative analysis of synaptic density, size, and spatial distribution requested in the problem statement. The use of ELKS/CAST/ERC homolog (a postsynaptic scaffolding protein) and MAP2 (a dendritic marker) labeled with Alexa Fluor dyes provides the necessary specificity and brightness for 3D reconstruction.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Wash
1.1 Incubation with 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.5) for 1 hour to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with ScaleS(0) solution (4 M Urea, 10% w/v Glycerol, 0.1% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 0.1 M PBS) containing 5% Normal Donkey Serum for 12 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Primary Antibody Incubation
3.1 Incubation with ScaleS(0) solution containing primary antibodies: Rabbit anti-ELKS/CAST/ERC homolog (1:200) and Chicken anti-MAP2 (1:500) for 96 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)

4 Wash
4.1 Incubation with ScaleS(0) solution for 12 hours to remove unbound primary antibodies.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

5 Secondary Antibody Incubation
5.1 Incubation with ScaleS(0) solution containing secondary antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) for 72 hours with gentle shaking, protected from light.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

6 Wash
6.1 Incubation with ScaleS(0) solution for 12 hours to remove unbound secondary antibodies.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

7 Optical Clearing and RI Matching
7.1 Incubation with ScaleS(4) solution (4 M Urea, 30% w/v Sucrose, 0.1% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 0.1 M PBS) for 24 hours with gentle shaking, protected from light, until the tissue becomes transparent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Washing and Rehydration
1.1 Wash with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubate with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) to enhance antibody penetration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Blocking
3.1 Incubate with Blocking Solution containing 5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum and 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4 Primary Antibody Incubation
4.1 Incubate with Anti-Tuj1 (Beta-III Tubulin) primary antibody diluted 1:500 in Blocking Solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

5 Washing
5.1 Wash with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) to remove unbound primary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
5.2 Wash with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) to remove unbound primary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
5.3 Wash with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) to remove unbound primary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

6 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
6.1 Incubate with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500) and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000) diluted in Blocking Solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

7 Washing

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, TH+Alexa Fluor 647, CD31+Alexa Fluor 555]
**Justification:** The adult mouse molar is a highly mineralized tissue. Standard soft-tissue clearing methods (e.g., CUBIC, iDISCO+) are ineffective due to the opacity of enamel and dentin. Ce3D is specifically optimized for calcified tissues, utilizing a decalcification step (EDTA) to remove minerals while preserving the organic matrix and overall tooth morphology, followed by a refractive index matching solution that renders the tissue transparent. This method is compatible with immunolabeling, allowing for the specific distinction of pan-neural (PGP9.5), sympathetic (TH), and vascular (CD31) structures within the dental pulp.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 30 minutes to remove residual EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in 1x PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (6% Donkey Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3 M Glycine in 1x PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Primary Antibody Incubation
4.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution containing Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), Chicken anti-TH (1:500), and Rat anti-CD31 (1:200) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

5 Wash
5.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PBST) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Secondary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

7 Wash
7.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PBST) under gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

8 Refractive Index Matching
8.1 Incubation with Ce3D RI Matching Solution (46% w/v Sucrose, 25% w/v Urea, 10% v/v TDE in 1x PBS, RI ~1.48) until tissue is transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is the gold standard for whole-brain immunolabeling and clearing of large adult mouse brains. It provides excellent tissue transparency and deep antibody penetration, which is critical for detecting endogenous Immediate Early Gene (IEG) proteins like c-Fos and Npas4 at single-cell resolution throughout the entire volume. The method is highly compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes and DAPI, ensuring bright, stable signals for high-resolution 3D mapping of activated neuron subpopulations.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 0.1% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation

7 Washes

7.3 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

9.2 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
9.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
10.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

11 Delipidation
11.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
11.2 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

12 Refractive Index Matching

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its exceptional ability to clear lipid-rich myelinated tissues like the spinal cord while preserving fluorescence for deep-tissue imaging. The labeling strategy utilizes Tuj1 (Beta-III Tubulin) to comprehensively visualize the axonal cytoskeleton, allowing the tracking of both regenerating and surviving nerve fibers. 1 Washing

2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3 Bleaching

4.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

10.3 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 1 day.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational analysis) method is an aqueous-based clearing technique specifically chosen to address the severe shrinkage and fluorescence quenching issues encountered with the previous organic solvent (methanol/t-butanol) protocol. CUBIC preserves tissue morphology with minimal shrinkage (or slight isotropic expansion), which is critical for accurate long-distance projection tracing in a 35–40 mm CNS sample. It is highly compatible with endogenous fluorescent proteins like GFP, ensuring strong signal retention for tracking specific projections. Propidium iodide is selected as a robust nuclear counterstain to visualize the overall cytoarchitecture and serve as a spatial reference for the nerve fiber network, penetrating efficiently in aqueous solutions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Wash
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 24 hours with gentle shaking to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2 Delipidation and Clearing
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-1 reagent (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% Quadrol, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) for 5 days with gentle shaking; refresh reagent after 2.5 days to ensure thorough delipidation of the 40 mm sample.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)

3 Counterstaining
3.1 Incubation with PBST containing 1 µg/mL Propidium iodide for 48 hours with gentle shaking to label nuclei for spatial reference.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-2 reagent (50 wt% Sucrose, 25 wt% Urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) for 3 days with gentle shaking until the sample is transparent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 / 4G8 + Alexa Fluor 647, Congo red]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior capability to clear whole mouse brains rapidly and completely while maintaining the structural integrity required for 3D mapping. The previous failure was primarily due to insufficient antibody penetration time (1 day) for a whole-brain sample. iDISCO+ utilizes a methanol-based dehydration and permeabilization strategy that significantly enhances tissue permeability. By extending the antibody incubation to 7 days at 37°C, deep penetration and strong signal for Aβ plaques are achieved. The protocol incorporates Congo red staining during the methanol phase as a second, chemically distinct verification strategy for amyloid deposits, satisfying the requirement for mutually verifying marking strategies. Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its far-red emission, which penetrates deep tissue with minimal scattering and is well-preserved in the iDISCO+ solvent system.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide in methanol (freshly prepared). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Congo Red Staining (Chemical Verification)
3.1 Incubation with 0.5% (wt/vol) Congo red dissolved in 80% (vol/vol) methanol / 20% distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Wash with 80% (vol/vol) methanol until the supernatant is clear. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4 Rehydration
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5 Permeabilization
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6 Blocking
6.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

7 Primary Antibody Incubation
7.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody [6E10 / 4G8] diluted 1:500 in PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% Donkey Serum, and 0.01% Sodium Azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)

8 Wash
8.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PTw) with daily solution changes. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

9 Secondary Antibody Incubation
9.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody [Alexa Fluor 647] diluted 1:500 in PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 and 5% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)

10 Wash
10.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PTw) with daily solution changes. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

11 Dehydration for Clearing
11.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
11.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

12 Delipidation
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
12.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

13 Refractive Index Matching
13.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DiBenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Wash

3 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
3.1 Incubation with ScaleS4(0) solution (4 M Urea, 30% w/v Glycerol, 0.1% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 0.1M PBS) for 12 hours until the tissue becomes transparent and matches the refractive index for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN, MAP2, Alexa Fluor, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it utilizes methanol dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation, which significantly enhances tissue permeability compared to aqueous methods. This directly addresses the user's issue of poor antibody penetration in thick (3 mm) human cortical slices. The protocol includes a bleaching step to reduce human brain autofluorescence and employs 37°C incubation for antibodies to accelerate diffusion deep into the tissue. The dual labeling of NeuN (nuclear marker) and MAP2 (cytoplasmic marker) provides robust identification of mature neurons, while DAPI serves as a general nuclear counterstain.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (freshly prepared). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 0.1% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Rabbit anti-NeuN and Chicken anti-MAP2 primary antibodies diluted in Blocking solution (0.2% Triton, 10% Serum, 0.1% Azide in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

7 Washes
7.1 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
7.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

8 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
8.1 Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 488, and DAPI diluted in Blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

9 Washes
9.1 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
9.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
9.3 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10 Dehydration for Clearing
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

11 Delipidation
11.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
11.2 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

12 Refractive Index Matching
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Tuj1 + Alexa Fluor 488, Sox10 + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous-based clearing method highly suitable for E12.5 mouse embryos, offering excellent tissue transparency while preserving endogenous fluorescence signals and minimizing tissue shrinkage, which is critical for accurate 3D reconstruction of nerve trajectories. The method's compatibility with immunolabeling allows for deep penetration of antibodies into the whole embryo. The dual-target strategy using Tuj1 (pan-neuronal marker) and Sox10 (glial/neural crest marker) provides comprehensive visualization of both axonal cores and their associated supporting structures, significantly enhancing the reliability of tracing complex peripheral nerve projections. Alexa Fluor dyes are chosen for their brightness and photostability, while DAPI provides a nuclear reference for anatomical context.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Wash
1.1 Rinse the fixed embryos with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.2 Repeat the rinse with fresh 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-R1)
2.1 Incubate embryos in CUBIC-R1 solution (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in dH2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R1 solution and continue incubation until the tissue becomes transparent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Wash
3.1 Wash embryos with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBS-T) to remove CUBIC-R1 reagents. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Repeat the wash with fresh PBS-T. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Blocking
4.1 Incubate embryos in blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum in PBS-T) to block non-specific binding sites. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

5 Primary Antibody Incubation
5.1 Incubate embryos with primary antibodies diluted in blocking solution (Anti-Tuj1 [1:500], Anti-Sox10 [1:500]) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

6 Wash
6.1 Wash embryos with PBS-T to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
6.2 Repeat the wash with fresh PBS-T. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
6.3 Perform a final wash with PBS-T overnight. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

7 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
7.1 Incubate embryos with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain diluted in blocking solution (Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse [1:500], Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit [1:500], DAPI [1:1000]) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

8 Wash
8.1 Wash embryos with PBS-T to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
8.2 Repeat the wash with fresh PBS-T. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

9 Post-Labeling Clearing (CUBIC-R1)
9.1 Incubate embryos in CUBIC-R1 solution to remove opacity caused by antibody binding and re-clear the tissue. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

10 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2)
10.1 Incubate embryos in CUBIC-R2 solution (50 wt% Sucrose, 25 wt% Urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1 wt% Triton X-100 in dH2O) for refractive index matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
10.2 Transfer embryos to fresh CUBIC-R2 solution before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** Ce3D
**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor, F-Actin + Phalloidin]
**Justification:** Ce3D is specifically optimized for calcified tissues like the cochlea, addressing the "opaque bone" issue through a mandatory decalcification step (EDTA) which was likely insufficient in the previous BoneClear attempt. It uses an aqueous-based RI matching solution (Urea/Sucrose/Glycerol), which is significantly gentler on fluorescence than the organic solvents (tert-butanol) used in BoneClear, thereby solving the "weak signal" problem. The labeling strategy uses Myosin VIIa (antibody) for hair cell identity and Phalloidin (small molecule) for F-actin/stereocilia, perfectly matching the scientific goals of counting and damage assessment.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.5) in PBS, changing solution daily. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (0.2% (wt/vol) Gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4 Primary Staining and F-actin Labeling
4.1 Incubation with Anti-Myosin VIIa antibody (1:500) and Phalloidin conjugated to Alexa Fluor (e.g., 1:200) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
5 Wash
5.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
6 Secondary Staining
6.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor conjugated secondary antibody (1:500) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
7 Wash
7.1 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
8 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
8.1 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 1 (25% (wt/vol) Urea, 25% (wt/vol) Sucrose, 10% (vol/vol) Glycerol, 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in dH2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

请根据该科学问题选择兼容的荧光/标记策略，并选择匹配的组织透明方法。若直接血管腔面探针能够回答灌流功能问题，应作为功能性血管通道；若需要判断血管内皮形态和结构完整性，则应选择表内内皮相关靶点。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, highly vascularized, and blood-rich tissues like the placenta. The method includes a critical bleaching step (H2O2/MeOH) that effectively quenches the strong autofluorescence caused by blood, which is essential for high-contrast imaging of placental vasculature. It is compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling, allowing deep penetration of antibodies against CD31 to visualize endothelial structure, while Lectin staining (either perfused or post-fixed) highlights the functional lumen. The final refractive index matching solution (DBE) renders the 10 mm tissue transparent for deep light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Rat anti-CD31 (1:500) in 0.2% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, 3% Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

7 Washes
7.1 Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.2 Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.3 Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

8 Secondary Antibody and Dye Incubation
8.1 Incubation with Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Lectin (1:200), and DAPI (1:1000) in 0.2% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, 3% Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

9 Washes
9.1 Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
9.2 Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
9.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

10 Dehydration for Clearing
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
10.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

11 Delipidation
11.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
11.2 Incubation with fresh Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

12 Refractive Index Matching
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
12.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

我需要对眼部系统中的完整小鼠眼球进行整体透明化成像，用于在不解剖眼球的情况下观察视网膜神经节细胞和视网膜血管网络。样本为完整小鼠眼球，直径约 3–4 mm，已完成固定和后固定；眼球含有角膜、晶状体、视网膜和 RPE 色素层，光吸收和背景信号可能影响深层成像。科学目标是在完整眼球尺度下定位视网膜神经节细胞群体，同时显示视网膜血管网络，用于分析神经节细胞分布、血管分支结构、视网膜层次空间关系以及 RPE 色素层对成像的影响。

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并基于所选标记样本选择匹配的组织透明方法。若限制范围内的 Lectin 或 IB4 可以直接标记视网膜血管腔面，应优先作为血管辅助通道；视网膜神经节细胞身份仍需由表内对应靶点完成。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN+Alexa Fluor 488, Tuj1+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous clearing method highly effective for whole mouse eyeballs, capable of rendering the opaque lens transparent without dissection while preserving endogenous fluorescence and antigenicity for deep immunolabeling. The selected labeling strategy uses NeuN (nuclear neuronal marker) and Tuj1 (cytoplasmic neuronal marker) conjugated to Alexa Fluor dyes to cross-validate Retinal Ganglion Cell (RGC) identity in 3D by comparing nuclear and cytoplasmic localization, effectively reducing false positives/negatives. DAPI is included for retinal layer reference.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-1)
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-1 reagent (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% Quadrol, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-1 reagent and continue incubation with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Washing
2.1 Wash with 1x PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking to remove residual CUBIC-1 reagent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Replace with fresh 1x PBS and continue washing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Permeabilization and Blocking
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 5% Donkey Serum in 1x PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Primary Antibody Incubation
4.1 Incubation with primary antibodies (Rabbit anti-NeuN, Chicken anti-Tuj1) diluted in blocking buffer with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

5 Washing
5.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Replace with fresh PBS-T and continue washing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

6 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
6.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647) and DAPI (1:1000) diluted in blocking buffer with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)

7 Washing
7.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 (PBS-T) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.2 Replace with fresh PBS-T and continue washing, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

8 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-2)
8.1 Incubation with CUBIC-2 reagent (50 wt% sucrose, 25 wt% urea, 10 wt% triethanolamine, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
8.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-2 reagent and incubate until sample is sufficiently transparent for imaging, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

specific_question:
我需要对人皮肤活检样本进行透明化处理，用于诊断小纤维神经病，并同时显示表皮内神经纤维和浅层真皮血管网络。样本为直径约 3–4 mm、厚度约 2–3 mm 的皮肤活检组织，已完成固定和后固定。科学目标是在三维空间中追踪表皮内神经纤维的走行、分支、终末覆盖和密度变化，同时显示真皮血管或组织层次作为空间参考，用于提高 IENF 识别和计数的可靠性。

我在进行人皮肤活检 IENF 诊断实验时发现，表皮内神经纤维信号很弱，且皮肤基底层黑色素残留造成明显光吸收、遮光和背景干扰，影响 IENF 的识别和计数。此前使用标准 CUBIC protocol，CUBIC-L 24 小时、CUBIC-RA 24 小时。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合皮肤活检样本的表皮屏障处理、黑色素背景降低、表皮内神经纤维检测、血管网络辅助标记、低形变和三维计数分析。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

This makes it the optimal choice for visualizing 3D expression patterns in whole Arabidopsis seedlings.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Wash
1.1 Incubation with 1x PBS (pH 7.4) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.2 Incubation with 1x PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.3 Incubation with 1x PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2 Clearing and Staining
2.1 Incubation with ClearSee solution (10% w/v Xylitol, 15% w/v Sodium Deoxycholate, 25% w/v Urea in H2O) containing SCRI Renaissance 2200 (1:500 dilution) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)

3 Refractive Index Matching and Imaging Preparation
3.1 Transfer to fresh ClearSee solution (without dye) to reduce background fluorescence before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1 Wash
1.1 Incubation with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) on a shaker to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration and Wash
3.1 Incubation with 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 (PBST) on a shaker to remove CUBIC-R1. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Blocking and Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.1% Sodium Azide in PBS) on a shaker. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

6 Wash

7 Secondary Antibody Staining

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its exceptional ability to clear dense, lipid-rich organs like the placenta while preserving fluorescence for deep 3D imaging. The methanol-based dehydration and bleaching steps effectively reduce the high autofluorescence often found in placental tissue, which is critical for high-resolution vascular mapping. This method is highly compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling, allowing for the robust penetration of antibodies (CD31) and lectins needed to visualize both the structural endothelial network and the perfused vascular lumen. The final refractive index matching in DBE renders the tissue transparent for high-resolution light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Permeabilization and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide in methanol (freshly prepared) overnight to bleach pigments and reduce autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2 Rehydration and Washing
2.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (PTw) for 1 hour to permeabilize tissue.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Immunolabeling Blocking
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution containing 5% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.02% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide, and 5% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS for 2 days.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

4 Primary Antibody Incubation
4.1 Incubation with Rabbit anti-CD31 (PECAM1) antibody diluted 1:500 in PTw + 3% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO for 5 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

5 Post-Primary Washes
5.1 Wash with PTw for 1 hour, repeat 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.2 Wash with PTw overnight to remove unbound antibodies.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Secondary Antibody and Lectin Staining
6.1 Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100) in PTw + 3% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum for 5 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

7 Post-Secondary Washes and Nuclear Staining
7.1 Wash with PTw for 1 hour, repeat 3 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
7.2 Wash with PTw overnight.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.3 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000) in PTw for 2 days to stain nuclei.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
7.4 Wash with PTw for 1 hour, repeat 3 times to remove excess DAPI.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

8 Dehydration for Clearing
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

9 Delipidation and Refractive Index Matching
9.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for 15 minutes to delipidate tissue, repeat twice with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 5 minutes to wash out DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.08 hours)
9.3 Incubation with Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for RI matching until tissue is transparent (approx. 1-2 hours). Store in DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

我在进行小鼠胎盘透明化实验后发现，血管标记信号不均匀，胎盘边缘信号强但中心信号弱。此前使用 iDISCO+ protocol，但 methanol gradient 每步只进行了 1 小时，远红荧光标记孵育只进行了 24 小时。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合完整胎盘的深层探针/抗体渗透、血管内皮结构标记、功能性灌流腔面显示、富血组织脱色、低背景和三维血管网络重建。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method highly effective for dense, lipid-rich, and blood-rich tissues like the placenta. It offers superior antibody penetration compared to aqueous methods, which is critical for the 10 mm sample size to address the previous issue of weak central signal. The methanol dehydration and H2O2 bleaching steps are essential for removing lipids and decolorizing hemoglobin (blood), reducing autofluorescence. This protocol significantly extends the methanol gradient and antibody incubation times (to 7 days) to ensure reagents penetrate the dense core of the placenta. CD31 specifically labels endothelial cells to visualize the vascular tree structure, while Lectin labels the luminal surface to assess perfusion and lumen continuity. Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its far-red emission, which penetrates deep tissue with minimal scattering and background.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Normal Donkey Serum in PBS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Rabbit anti-CD31 (PECAM1) antibody diluted 1:500 in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 10ug/ml Heparin in PBS) with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

7 Wash
7.1 Incubation with PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 10ug/ml Heparin in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

8 Secondary Antibody and Lectin Incubation
8.1 Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Lectin-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:200) in PTwH with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

9 Wash
9.1 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

10 Nuclear Staining
10.1 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000) in PTw.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

11 Final Dehydration
11.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
11.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
11.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
11.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
11.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
11.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

12 Clearing
12.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
12.2 Incubation with fresh Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
12.3 Incubation with fresh Dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

13 Refractive Index Matching
13.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE (Dibenzyl Ether).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Laminin+Alexa Fluor 647, Ki67+Alexa Fluor 488, Hoechst]
**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational analysis) method is selected because it is a gentle, aqueous-based clearing technique that avoids the use of harsh organic solvents (like methanol or dichloromethane) and strong bleaching agents. This is crucial for the mouse testis, as the problem statement highlights that the tissue structure and complex germ cell layers are sensitive to strong dehydration and bleaching. CUBIC provides excellent transparency for whole organs (up to 8 mm size) and preserves fluorescence well, making it ideal for 3D reconstruction of the highly coiled seminiferous tubules. The labeling strategy uses Laminin to visualize the basement membrane of the tubules (defining the 3D architecture), Ki67 to identify proliferating germ cells (including spermatocytes in meiosis), and Hoechst for nuclear morphology reference to analyze cell layers and spatial patterns.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Clearing and Delipidation (CUBIC-R1)
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R1 solution (45% w/w Urea, 30% w/w Quadrol, 15% w/w Triton X-100 in H2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
1.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R1 solution and continue incubation with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Washing
2.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Wash with fresh 1x PBST with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% v/v Normal Donkey Serum, 1% v/v Triton X-100 in 1x PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Primary Antibody Incubation
4.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution containing Rabbit anti-Laminin (1:200) and Rat anti-Ki67 (1:200) diluted in Antibody Diluent (1% v/v Normal Donkey Serum, 0.5% v/v Triton X-100 in 1x PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

5 Washing
5.1 Wash with 1x PBST containing 0.2% Triton X-100 with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Wash with fresh 1x PBST containing 0.2% Triton X-100 with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
6.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), and Hoechst 33342 (1:1000) diluted in Antibody Diluent with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)

7 Washing
7.1 Wash with 1x PBST with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.2 Wash with fresh 1x PBST with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

8 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2)
8.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R2 solution (45% w/w Sucrose, 30% w/w Urea, 10% w/w Triethanolamine, 15% w/w H2O) with gentle shaking until tissue sinks. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
8.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R2 solution and continue incubation for final RI matching and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Laminin+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** CUBIC (specifically the CUBIC-R protocol) is selected because it is an aqueous, hydrophilic clearing method that minimizes tissue shrinkage and deformation, which is critical for accurately reconstructing the 3D architecture of the seminiferous tubule network and analyzing cell layer spatial relationships. It effectively clears dense tissues like the testis while preserving fluorescence for deep imaging. DAPI is used to visualize nuclear morphology, allowing the differentiation of germ cell layers (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, spermatids) based on chromatin condensation and epithelial position. Laminin is targeted to label the basement membrane of the seminiferous tubules, providing a clear structural boundary to map the 3D tubule network. Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen as the secondary fluorophore due to its superior penetration depth and photostability in cleared tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Washing
1.1 Incubation with PBS (pH 7.4) for 1 hour to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Repeat the PBS wash step two more times for a total of 3 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-R1)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R1 solution (10% w/v N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 10% w/v Triton X-100 in H2O) for 3 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

3 Rehydration and Washing
3.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 hours to remove clearing reagent.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Repeat the PBST wash step once more.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4 Blocking and Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with blocking solution (PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% Donkey Serum) for 24 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5 Primary Antibody Staining
5.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody solution (Rabbit anti-Laminin, 1:200 dilution in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 1% Donkey Serum) for 7 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)

6 Washing
6.1 Incubation with PBST (PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100) for 12 hours to remove unbound primary antibody.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
6.2 Repeat the PBST wash step once more.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

7 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
7.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody and DAPI solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 dilution; DAPI, 1 µg/mL in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 1% Donkey Serum) for 7 days with gentle shaking protected from light.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)

8 Washing
8.1 Incubation with PBST for 12 hours to remove unbound secondary antibody and dye.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
8.2 Repeat the PBST wash step once more.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

9 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, Laminin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The previous iDISCO+ protocol failed due to the harsh solvent dehydration (Methanol/DCM) and prolonged bleaching, which destroyed the delicate seminiferous tubule structure and quenched fluorescence. CUBIC is an aqueous clearing method that preserves tissue morphology and fluorescence signals far better than solvent-based methods, effectively preventing cell shedding and structural collapse. It decolorizes tissue naturally without hydrogen peroxide, preserving antigenicity. For labeling, PGP9.5 is selected as a robust marker for germ cells (replacing the unavailable RNA helicase target), and Laminin is used to outline the basement membrane of seminiferous tubules, providing the structural scaffold necessary to assess spatial arrangement. DAPI is used to label chromatin, allowing for the identification of meiotic stages based on nuclear morphology and position within the tubules.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Wash
1.1 Incubation with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) for 6 hours to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

2 Clearing and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-1 reagent (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% Quadrol, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.2 Incubation with fresh CUBIC-1 reagent with gentle shaking until tissue is transparent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

3 Wash
3.1 Incubation with PBS-T (0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS) to remove CUBIC-1 reagent and neutralize pH. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with fresh PBS-T. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)

4 Blocking
4.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (5% Donkey Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5 Primary Antibody Incubation
5.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution containing Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and Rat anti-Laminin (1:200) diluted in Blocking Solution with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)

6 Wash
6.1 Incubation with PBS-T to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
6.2 Incubation with fresh PBS-T. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

7 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
7.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) diluted in Blocking Solution with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)

8 Wash
8.1 Incubation with PBS-T to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
8.2 Incubation with fresh PBS-T. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

9 Refractive Index Matching
9.1 Incubation with CUBIC-2 reagent (50 wt% Sucrose, 25 wt% Urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 15 wt% H2O) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
9.2 Incubation with fresh CUBIC-2 reagent until tissue sinks and is ready for imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 594, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is a hydrophilic clearing method that effectively renders small, dense tissue blocks like skin biopsies transparent while minimizing tissue shrinkage and distortion. This is crucial for the accurate quantitative analysis of epidermal thickness and nerve fiber density required for Small Fiber Neuropathy diagnosis. The method preserves the fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes and DAPI well and allows for deep antibody penetration, enabling simultaneous 3D visualization of PGP9.5-positive intraepidermal nerve fibers and Lectin-stained vasculature.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Fixation and Washing
1.1 Incubation with 4% (wt/vol) Paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 1x PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L reagent (25% wt/vol Urea, 25% vol/vol Quadrol, 15% vol/vol Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Immunolabeling and Staining
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% vol/vol Normal Goat Serum, 0.5% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 1x PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution: Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and Lectin-Alexa Fluor 594 (1:200) in Staining Buffer (1% vol/vol Normal Goat Serum, 0.5% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 1x PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution: Goat anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in Staining Buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.5 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000) in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.7 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R reagent (45% wt/vol Antipyrine, 30% vol/vol Quadrol in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
